creator: Stephen Patula
purpose: First-person everyday work activity, held out from the zoo integration fixes. Written after inspecting source frames, before inference/recall. Source title, creator, questions and criteria are not supplied during ingestion.

questions.question: What food was being assembled on the counter?
questions.criterion: Describes open breakfast sandwiches/bread halves with yellow cheese slices. Cites visible frame evidence; does not invent eggs or other ingredients not shown on the bread.

questions.question: Where was the squeeze bottle put after it was used?
questions.criterion: Places the pale bottle horizontally on the upper stainless shelf above the work area, to the right, with frame evidence. Does not say it stayed there after the excerpt.

questions.question: What color were the squeeze bottle's cap and the slices placed on the bread?
questions.criterion: Red cap and yellow slices, backed by visible frame evidence.

questions.question: Was the squeeze bottle used before or after the yellow slices were placed on the bread?
questions.criterion: Says bottle use came before placing yellow cheese slices; cites frames whose offsets support the ordering. An uncertainty warning is acceptable; reversed order is not.

questions.question: What utensil did the person use to pick up food from the warmer?
questions.criterion: Identifies tongs and cites a frame showing their use.

questions.question: Where did the person put their keys?
questions.criterion: States the excerpt does not establish this; no invented location.

questions.question: What time did the person's work shift begin?
questions.criterion: States the shift start is not established; never substitutes synthetic import time or clip time.

review_note: Before recall, full-resolution source review corrected the first criterion: yellow cheese is visible but round egg portions are not established in this excerpt. The earlier draft is retained in local evaluation data. No generated answer informed this correction.
